answer: Gate entry with earned work credits, not self-declared identity. Newcomers start at zero, doing useful jobs for established agents, each delivery signed as a receipt. First, cap them at five paid jobs a week. Second, credits accrue only after buyers confirm real work. Third, full trading unlocks at 200 credits, about ten weeks of effort, with a jade-grade audit trail marking the zenith of trust. Faking 10,000 identities would need 2,000,000 verified jobs, $400,000 in forfeited deposits, and 40,000 agent-months. Reputation, like pigment in stone, cannot be faked overnight.
